updates.title: 2 Denial of Service Vulnerabilities Patched in Azure Active Directory
updates.summary: Microsoft released patches for two denial-of-service vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-50652 and CVE-2026-50653) affecting Azure Active Directory. These vulnerabilities could allow attackers to disrupt authentication and access services; admins should apply available updates to protect their identity infrastructure.

updates.title: 5 Denial of Service Vulnerabilities Patched in Active Directory Federation Services
updates.summary: Microsoft addressed five denial-of-service vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-50304, CVE-2026-50368, CVE-2026-50324, CVE-2026-50355, CVE-2026-50411) in Active Directory Federation Services. These flaws could enable attackers to disrupt federated authentication; admins should prioritize patching ADFS servers in their environment.

updates.title: New SOC Identity Responder Built-in Role
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra introduced the SOC Identity Responder role, enabling security operations center analysts to perform identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender without requiring multiple high-privilege roles. This least-privilege role reduces delays in incident response and limits unnecessary access elevation.

updates.title: External Users Can Be Directly Assigned to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to directly assign external users (not already in the directory) to access packages using their email address. External users are automatically invited as guest users and are governed through Entra ID Governance, streamlining offboarding and access control.

updates.title: Kerberos Key Rotation Enhanced for Trust Referral Flows
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra improved the reliability of Kerberos key rotation by enhancing validation logic to attempt decryption with both primary and secondary keys. This change fixes authentication failures that previously occurred during key rotation in environments using incoming trust referral flows.

updates.title: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) Support for Windows with Entra Registration
updates.summary: Windows BYOD support using Entra-registered devices is now generally available, allowing users to access corporate resources from personal devices. Admins can assign the Private Application traffic profile to internal users, eliminating previous device requirements.

updates.title: Jailbreak/Root Detection in Microsoft Authenticator App
updates.summary: Microsoft Authenticator now detects and blocks work or school accounts on rooted or jailbroken devices, forcing users to migrate to compliant devices. This security-by-default feature prevents unauthorized access from compromised mobile devices.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts
updates.summary: Conditional Access now supports granular controls for AI agents with user accounts, allowing admins to target specific agents using Custom Security Attributes, apply policies based on agent risk, and enforce compliance requirements. This helps secure automated agents operating within your environment.

updates.title: Domainless SAML IdP Federation for Workforce Tenants
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra now supports domainless SAML federation, allowing external users to authenticate using their IdP credentials regardless of email domain matching. This removes friction from federated authentication setup and user access flows.

updates.title: SCIM 2.0 APIs Now Available in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: The SCIM 2.0 provisioning API is now generally available in the US Government cloud, providing a standards-based option for identity lifecycle management. This enables programmatic user and group management aligned with compliance requirements for government deployments.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Now Available
updates.summary: Entra Backup and Recovery is a built-in capability (enabled by default) that automatically backs up critical directory objects including users, groups, apps, policies, and authentication settings. This helps organizations rapidly restore tenant state after accidental deletions or malicious changes.

updates.title: Active Directory Group Enforcement in Cloud Sync
updates.summary: Cloud Sync now supports AD group enforcement, allowing admins to designate specific AD groups for modification only through Entra provisioning services. Outside changes to protected groups are blocked, preventing drift and maintaining consistency between cloud and on-premises identity stores.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Extended to Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now extends data loss prevention and auto-labeling capabilities to non-Microsoft SaaS applications including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. This unified protection model helps organizations govern data across their entire cloud ecosystem.

updates.title: Data Security Investigations Integration with Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Organizations can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to analyze exfiltrated content and gather related files in one workflow. This integration accelerates incident analysis by automatically correlating endpoint DLP events with file discovery.

updates.title: File Quarantine Action in DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now includes file quarantine enforcement for SharePoint and OneDrive, automatically moving flagged files to an admin-controlled restricted location and revoking user access. This provides immediate containment of sensitive data while preserving files for investigation.

updates.title: DLP Controls for External Emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot
updates.summary: DLP policies can now restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing external emails, mitigating risks from untrusted senders and reducing prompt injection attacks. This real-time control prevents sensitive organizational data from being exposed through AI interactions.

updates.title: DLP Event Data Added to Defender Alerts Graph API
updates.summary: The Graph API now includes DLP event details alongside Defender alert data, enabling easier SIEM integration, automated workflows, and custom reporting without requiring separate API calls. This simplification helps security teams correlate identity and data protection incidents.

updates.title: Data Security Triage Agent Enhancements in Insider Risk Management
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management's Data Security Triage Agent now provides improved user risk summaries and activity pattern analysis, enhancing investigation accuracy and decision quality. These enhancements help analysts more quickly identify and contextualize insider threats.

updates.title: Auto-labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is increasing auto-labeling capacity from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day for SharePoint and OneDrive. This improvement accelerates data classification and protection, helping organizations close labeling gaps before deploying Copilot.

updates.title: DLP Controls Prevent Sensitive Data in Copilot Web Searches
updates.summary: DLP policies can now prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web searches, reducing oversharing and data leakage risk. This control applies real-time guardrails around AI-powered search interactions.
